title: mcp/server approval entry
description: MCP spawn approval list entry (governance dataset org.evorule.mcp.servers). Unlike the other builtin shells this one is intentionally strict: the approval list is a security control surface, so the six mandatory attribution and identity fields are required out of the box (fresh deployments and in-memory stores included). server_key must equal the canonical hash of command+args_pattern; the cross-field check is enforced in the store write core (this schema alone cannot express it). entry_id convention = server_key. The executor side (agent spawn gate) mirrors this contract and aligns via shared golden vector tests.
